prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: reusable empty desktop-companion background, final vertical 1024x1536 image.
Primary request: a cozy contemporary Suzhou apartment reading nook in daytime. Warm ivory walls, lightly textured light-oak floor, a tall window on the LEFT, a modest bookcase far in the back RIGHT, and one restrained green plant. Keep the central foreground floor completely clear for later compositing of a full-body adult person at normalized placement x=0.22, y=0.12, width=0.60, height=0.82; no chair or foreground furniture may overlap that center zone. Leave the bottom 10 percent as plausible visible floor for feet.
Subject: empty interior; absolutely no people.
Style/medium: high-quality photoreal interior photograph, real natural materials and subtle lived-in texture, no illustration, CGI, dollhouse effect, or miniature effect.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3, chest-level camera, moderate natural perspective, no fisheye, central foreground negative space reserved for compositing.
Lighting/mood: soft daytime natural light from the upper LEFT, matching a gentle portrait lighting direction.
Constraints: no person, no chair in the central foreground, no text, logos, watermark, or baked-in character. This must be a standalone reusable background.

qa.notes: Empty photoreal interior; left window, far-right bookcase, clear central oak floor, and compatible left-side daylight are present.
